extraction.notes: Three-month column, Q4 2022, from Supplemental Schedule 1. Company reports NAREIT FFO and Pro forma FFO (used here as the adjusted FFO metric); no AFFO metric is reported, so affo fields are null. Verified: 329,279 + adjustments = 87,725; 87,725 + adjustments = 89,124. Share count 149,996 reproduces FFO per share: 87,725/149,996 = $0.58 and 89,124/149,996 = $0.59. Two core items printed as dashes for the quarter (loss on extinguishment of debt, tax adjustment) and one (incremental cash received from leased properties) are recorded as 0. Tax adjustment and incremental cash items are categorized as 'other'. recurring_capex_disclosed left null because the company has no AFFO section; for reference, Supplemental Schedule 9 (page seq 32, printed 30) shows Q4 2022 consolidated Capital Replacements of $9,615 thousand (company total, not adjusted for noncontrolling interests, excludes sold/held-for-sale properties).
